pick.title: zencontrol controllers found
pick.description: These controllers answered in your network. Choose the one to add. If yours is missing, choose the last entry and type its address.

manual.title: zencontrol TPI Advanced (Unilight)
manual.description: Local connection to a zencontrol controller over TPI Advanced (UDP). The controller needs the TPI Advanced licence and must be on the same network as this computer.

data_description.host: IP address of the controller in the local network.
data_description.skip_test: Tick only when you are sure TPI is on but the test fails.

confirm.title: zencontrol controller found
confirm.description: Add the controller **{name}** ({host}) to Home Assistant?

reconfigure.title: Change controller address
reconfigure.description: Use this when the controller got a new IP address. Devices and entities stay as they are.

error.cannot_connect: No reply from the controller. Check the IP address, that this computer is in the same network as the controller, and that TPI is enabled.
error.paid_feature: The controller answered PAID_FEATURE: TPI Advanced is not licensed or not enabled on this controller.
error.unexpected_reply: The controller answered with an error. See Settings > System > Logs (search for zencontrol).

abort.not_tpi_controller: The device did not answer as a zencontrol controller with TPI Advanced.

data.scan_interval: Read levels from the controller every (seconds, 5-600)
data.include_unlabelled: Also show fixtures without a label in zencontrol
data.events_enabled: Receive events from the controller (instant light states, motion sensors, panel keys)
data.event_host: IP address of this computer (where the controller sends events). Leave empty to detect it automatically
data.occupancy_hold: Motion sensor shows "clear" after (seconds without motion, 5-3600)

data_description.scan_interval: How quickly changes made from wall panels show up in Home Assistant.
data_description.include_unlabelled: Fixtures without a label are usually leftovers in the controller's database.
data_description.events_enabled: The integration tells the controller to send its events to the address below. The setting is not permanent on the controller: it disappears when the controller restarts and the integration sets it again.
data_description.event_host: The address of the computer running Home Assistant in the local network, the same one you type on the phone. Leave it empty when Home Assistant is in the same network as the controller; type it when Home Assistant runs in Docker with its own network or in a virtual machine behind NAT.
data_description.event_port: If Home Assistant runs in Docker, this UDP port must be published to the container (for example 6969:6969/udp).
data_description.sensors_enabled: Each motion sensor becomes a binary sensor. Needs receiving events switched on.
data_description.buttons_enabled: Each key becomes an event entity (press / hold) for automations. Needs receiving events switched on.

error.event_host_required: The address of this computer could not be detected. Enter its IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.57.
error.event_host_is_controller: This is the controller's address. Enter the address of the computer running Home Assistant.

send_command.name: Send TPI command
send_command.description: Sends one basic TPI frame. The start byte 04, sequence number and checksum are added automatically. Returns the controller's reply.

command.name: Command
command.description: Command byte, for example 0x1C (controller version) or 0xA2 (arc level).

address.name: Address byte
address.description: 0-63 short address, 64+n group n, 255 broadcast. For queries about groups use the group number.

data.name: Data
data.description: Up to 3 data bytes, for example 0x00 0x00 0xFE.

host.name: Controller IP
host.description: Only needed when more than one controller is added.

send_raw.name: Send raw bytes
send_raw.description: Sends your hex bytes exactly as typed. Returns the controller's reply.

payload.name: Bytes (hex)
payload.description: Whole frame, for example 04 00 A9 FF 00 00 00.

add_checksum.name: Add checksum
add_checksum.description: Append the XOR checksum to the bytes.

host.name: Controller IP
host.description: Only needed when more than one controller is added.

arc_level.name: Set arc level
arc_level.description: DALI direct arc level (0-254) for a fixture, a group or the whole line.

address.name: Fixture address
address.description: DALI short address 0-63. Give exactly one of: address, group, broadcast.

broadcast.name: Broadcast
broadcast.description: Send to the whole DALI line.

host.name: Controller IP
host.description: Only needed when more than one controller is added.
